notes: SYNTHETIC development fixture, not captured from hardware. A service's debug logging runs away, writing log files into its own container filesystem until it exceeds its ephemeral-storage limit and the kubelet evicts it. The disk hardware is healthy and the node is under no disk pressure; the workload is the cause of the storage symptom. A per-pod limit, rather than node DiskPressure, because the rig must never fill the kubelet's filesystem, on the boot disk.
